scientific_integrity: The coefficientwise Fourier idempotence identity and Peirce-block dichotomy are explicitly credited to their earlier sources; the proposed contribution is the arithmetic orbit-weight factorization and multiplicity census.
scientific_limitations: Finite abelian groups of odd order over the complex numbers; right multiplication only. Direct finite checks do not replace the proof. The antecedent Fourier idempotence equation and three-valued Peirce set are established prior results. Publication priority of the new weighted orbit enumeration is not exhaustive.
title: An exact idempotent and Peirce-multiplicity census for odd-order core quandle algebras
